name: Sealer Coat - int_door_slab
intent: One sealer coat + sand. Sand fires after every sealer coat (clear follows). Repeats per ctx.sealer_coats via scenario.dynamic_coats. Mirrors MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_APPLY_SEALER but with EA_SIDE keeper tasks for door slabs.
doctrine: Sealer for int_door_slab. Sand fires after every sealer coat (220-320 grit typical) so the last sealer is sanded before clear goes over. Brush variant gets WB_SEALER_BRUSH 0.9× time (faster than paint by brush); spray variant gets WB_SEALER_SPRAY 1.0× (sprayer viscosity-agnostic).
